moments.title: Strictly Come Dancing is BACK!
moments.blurb: The 24th series of Strictly Come Dancing kicks off tonight with its highly anticipated launch show on BBC One, revealing this year's celebrity-professional pairings.

angles.name: Launch Night Excitement
angles.copy: Dust off your dancing shoes! Strictly Come Dancing returns to BBC One tonight for its glittering 2026 launch show. Who are you most excited to see hit the ballroom?

angles.name: New Hosts on the Block
angles.copy: Big changes in the ballroom! Emma Willis, Josh Widdicombe, and Johannes Radebe take over hosting duties for Strictly Come Dancing series 24, starting tonight. Ready for the new era?

moments.title: Premier League Matchweek 5 Action
moments.blurb: Matchweek 5 of the Premier League continues today and tomorrow across the UK, with teams battling for early season points.

angles.name: Saturday Football Buzz
angles.copy: It's Premier League Saturday! Who are you backing to win today? Let us know your score predictions for Matchweek 5!

angles.name: Sunday Showdowns
angles.copy: Super Sunday is here! Premier League Matchweek 5 wraps up with some massive clashes. Which game are you glued to this afternoon?

moments.title: Sienna Spiro tops UK Singles Chart
moments.blurb: Sienna Spiro holds the No. 1 spot on the Official UK Singles Chart as of September 18, 2026, with her hit track 'Great Expectation'.

angles.name: Chart Topper
angles.copy: Still at number one! Sienna Spiro's 'Great Expectation' remains the UK's biggest song this week. Have you been streaming it non-stop?

angles.name: Weekend Playlist
angles.copy: What's on your weekend playlist? The Official UK Singles Chart is out, and Sienna Spiro is still leading the pack with 'Great Expectation'. Tune in for the biggest hits!

moments.title: Diljit Dosanjh in Birmingham
moments.blurb: Global Punjabi superstar Diljit Dosanjh brings his 'AURA World Tour' to Utilita Arena Birmingham tonight, September 19, for a highly anticipated show.

angles.name: Birmingham Aura
angles.copy: Birmingham! Tonight, Diljit Dosanjh lights up the Utilita Arena with his 'AURA World Tour'. Who's ready for a night of incredible music?

angles.name: Live Music Energy
angles.copy: The 'AURA World Tour' hits Birmingham tonight! Diljit Dosanjh is bringing the energy to Utilita Arena. Expect an unforgettable performance!

moments.title: Happy 77th to Twiggy
moments.blurb: Legendary model, actress, and singer Twiggy (Lesley Lawson) celebrates her 77th birthday today, September 19.

angles.name: Iconic Birthday
angles.copy: Sending birthday wishes to the iconic Twiggy, who turns 77 today! A true fashion and music legend. What's your favourite Twiggy moment?

moments.title: Alison Moyet turns 65
moments.blurb: The incredible voice of Alison Moyet celebrates her 65th birthday today, September 19. The former Yazoo singer has had a stellar solo career.

angles.name: 80s Legend Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 65th Birthday to the phenomenal Alison Moyet! From Yazoo to her incredible solo hits, her voice is timeless. What's your go-to Alison Moyet track?

moments.title: Great British Bake Off returns
moments.blurb: Get your aprons ready! The 17th series of The Great British Bake Off begins on Tuesday, September 22, at 8pm on Channel 4, with Nigella Lawson joining as a new judge.

angles.name: Bake Off Anticipation
angles.copy: It's almost time! The Great British Bake Off is back this Tuesday on Channel 4. Who's excited for soggy bottoms and Hollywood handshakes?

angles.name: New Judge Alert
angles.copy: A new ingredient in the tent! Nigella Lawson joins Paul Hollywood as a judge for the new series of The Great British Bake Off, starting Tuesday. Thoughts?

moments.title: Autumn Equinox on Wednesday
moments.blurb: The astronomical Autumn Equinox occurs on Wednesday, September 23, at 1:06 AM BST, marking the official start of autumn in the Northern Hemisphere.

angles.name: First Day of Autumn
angles.copy: Get ready for crunching leaves and pumpkin spice everything! Wednesday marks the Autumn Equinox, officially ushering in the new season. What's your favourite thing about autumn?

angles.name: Longer Nights Ahead
angles.copy: The nights draw in! The Autumn Equinox on Wednesday means days get shorter and nights get longer in the Northern Hemisphere. More time for cosy nights in!

moments.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
moments.blurb: Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher, born September 21. The voice of Oasis continues to rock stages worldwide.

angles.name: Rock 'n' Roll Star Birthday
angles.copy: Our kid's still got it! Wishing a very Happy 54th Birthday to the legendary Liam Gallagher today. What's your favourite Oasis anthem?

moments.title: Bruce Springsteen's 77th
moments.blurb: The Boss, Bruce Springsteen, celebrates his 77th birthday on Wednesday, September 23. A true rock legend with decades of iconic music.

angles.name: The Boss's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 77th Birthday to the one and only Boss, Bruce Springsteen, this Wednesday! What's the ultimate Springsteen track for you?

moments.title: Gallagher Premiership Rugby Kicks Off
moments.blurb: The 2026/27 Gallagher Premiership Rugby season begins next weekend, September 25-27, with defending champions Northampton Saints in action.

angles.name: Rugby Season Begins
angles.copy: The wait is over! Gallagher Premiership Rugby kicks off next weekend. Who are you backing for the title this season?

angles.name: Exeter Chiefs Return
angles.copy: For Radio Exe listeners, our very own Exeter Chiefs are back in Premiership Rugby action next weekend! Get ready to cheer them on!

moments.title: Strictly Live Shows Begin
moments.blurb: After tonight's launch, the first live shows of Strictly Come Dancing 2026 will air next Saturday, September 26, as the couples perform for the judges' scores.

angles.name: Live Show Countdown
angles.copy: The real competition begins! The first live shows of Strictly Come Dancing 2026 are next Saturday. Who do you think will impress the judges?

moments.title: Catherine Zeta-Jones turns 57
moments.blurb: Welsh actress Catherine Zeta-Jones celebrates her 57th birthday on Wednesday, September 25. The Oscar-winner hails from Swansea.

angles.name: Welsh Star Birthday
angles.copy: Penblwydd Hapus to our very own Welsh icon, Catherine Zeta-Jones, who turns 57 this Wednesday! From Swansea to Hollywood, a true star.

angles.name: Local Pride
angles.copy: Happy Birthday to Swansea's own Catherine Zeta-Jones this Wednesday! What's your favourite movie role of hers?

moments.title: Roger Taylor at Roundhouse
moments.blurb: Queen drummer Roger Taylor performs at London's iconic Roundhouse on Monday, September 28, marking his only UK shows this year.

angles.name: Queen Legend Live
angles.copy: A Queen legend in London! Roger Taylor takes to the stage at the Roundhouse this Monday for a rare UK show. Who's going?
